svg.title: Glass Garden — tic80 run postcard
svg.desc: A glowing marker represents the fraction of adjacent frame fingerprints that changed in each frame-coordinate bucket. The meadow plot counts normalized events by their frame coordinate. Event kinds are listed separately; channel ordering is not inferred.
svg.text: 599 of 599 adjacent fingerprint pairs changed (100.0%) · frame coordinate
